text_block_list.text:
As I was walking down the hallway... I 
heard some Umamusume arguing.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Sitting around here is blocking the 
hallway. If you want to chat, why don't 
you head to the cafeteria?

text_block_list.name: Delinquent Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you exaggerating? We were just 
shooting the breeze.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I don't care about your excuses. Get out 
of the way. Right now.

A resolute, assertive demeanor. Later that 
afternoon, after feeling how 
unapproachable she seemed—
Big sisters~! P-L-E-A-S-E~~!!

I turned toward the direction of the 
voice...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Honestly... once we get back from 
shopping, you have homework to do, okay? 
Cheval, you should also take a quick 
breather and――
choice_data_list: (――! It's that feisty girl from earlier……)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not going. I want to train, so...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Understood, Cheval. Just please don't 
overdo it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I know... See you later, Sister, Vivlos...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Come now, Vivlos. Weren't you going 
shopping? Go get ready to head out.
choice_data_list:
(She gives off a totally different 
impression than before――)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, dear. I hope we weren't being too 
noisy. My apologies.
choice_data_list:
No, seeing your sisterly bond was really 
heartwarming.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, dear. I hope we weren't being too 
noisy. My apologies.
choice_data_list:
No, seeing your sisterly bond was really 
heartwarming.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That's simply what being an older sister 
is all about. It's no burden at all.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Serving as an honorable role model for my 
little sister and indulging her whims are 
both part of my duties as an elder sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, it's about time I get going. My 
little sister is waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... They can be quite a handful, but 
they're my beloved little sisters.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I sometimes wonder if I pamper her too 
much. I suppose I still have a long way to 
go as an older sister.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Well then, it's about time I get going. My 
little sister is waiting for me.
